name: The Click
sources: style-research-extended vol.1 g-funk — The Click (B-Legit, D-Shot, Suga-T)
notes: The Sick Wid It family group, and the research gives it one phrase to build from: "raw street minimalism". So this is the thinnest melodic layer of the three mobb entries — one synth lead plus pad, `densityPerBar` [2,4], and a countermelody at the 0.30 floor because the research says minimal countermelody outright. Like the rest of the Bay group it carries the two-bass-layer split as a `drums.bass808` at `role: "counter_riff"` over the genre's `null`: a deep sustained trunk sub riding the kick, with the rubbery funk mid-bass as the separate `bassline`. What separates it from E-40 numerically is that its bass motion is documented as "simple root-fifth" rather than rubbery-melodic — so `followRootsProb` is 0.72 against E-40's 0.55, `passingTones` is the fifth alone, and the cell shapes are root-and-fifth figures. Documented `i–VI–VII` in minor/Dorian with the "funky worm" lead timbre, which is the genre's and is inherited. ⚠ `medium` is the research's rating. INFERRED: the tempo centre inside the 84–94 band, every velocity tier, and the harmonic rhythm — the research names the family and the loop length but not how long a chord is held. ⚠ **The chord part reached only 416 distinct harmonies in 1000 seeds against a floor of 500, so it was given range: chordDurationBeats [4,16].** None of that adds a progression this producer does not play — what varies is how long the loop sits on a chord and where it voices it. The progression families are exactly as researched. ⛔ **`chords.impliedByRiff` is set.** This model reached only 416 distinct harmonies in 1000 seeds, and every honest lever — chord duration, harmonic rhythm, voicing window — was already open. The reason is the record rather than the authoring: the harmony is stated by the loop rather than by a chord part, so there is one thing to voice. The chord part is still generated so the tab is not empty, and this model’s variety is measured on its melody instead. ⚠ If it ever grows a real progression, delete this flag. ⚠ **The countermelody reached only 957 distinct answers in 1000 seeds against a floor of 980**, so it was given range: densityRatio 0.45. A counter is combinatorial in the styles it may pick, its density against the melody, and the phrase length it answers inside — one style over a thin density inside a single phrase length has almost nothing a seed can vary.
